South Korea President Urges Trump-Kim Talks, US Investment Progress

South Korean President Moon Jae-in has urged for renewed talks between US President Donald Trump and North Korean leader Kim Jong Un to break the current stalemate. Simultaneously, South Korea has reported that President Trump welcomed progress in US strategic investment projects with South Korea. The specific details of these investment projects were not provided.
